interface.ports: one byte-enabled 128-bit write port per logical bank; B2/B3/B10/B11 have paired even/odd 128-bit read stripes returning 256 bits together; other banks retain 128-bit reads
interface.ownership: owned by common bank_ownership_table and checked by router, not memory

numeric.byte_order: 16 consecutive bytes form one 128-bit word; byte strobes address corresponding little-endian byte lanes

control_rules.read: three-cycle synchronous read; wide requests use even 128-bit word addresses and return {word[a+1],word[a]}; narrow requests select one half
control_rules.write: byte strobes control each of the 16 bytes; address outside bank capacity is rejected by common wrapper
control_rules.chunk: END/DONE does not reset or clear memory; reset clears read outputs but tensor_valid is maintained separately
control_rules.completion: DMA or compute done must occur only after the last accepted bank write; this memory module does not generate command completion

required_cases: first and last word of every bank
simultaneous read and write at different addresses
data retention across a chunk gap and reset
Vivado BRAM/URAM primitive count and 200 MHz OOC timing
even/odd 128-bit writes and one paired 256-bit read on every GEMM source bank
verification.proof_scope: physical local storage only; no DDR integration, compute arithmetic, routed board implementation or physical-board inference
